shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch RadioButton useTheme ThemeContext

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch RadioButton useTheme; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -C3 'ThemeProvider\|system\|useThemeValue\|useTheme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme build/esm/components/theme/* 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/useTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/RadioButton; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/index.d.ts components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts; ls components/theme | grep -i use; ls components/RadioButton* components/Switch* 2>/dev/null | head; ls components | grep -i -E 'radio|switch|select'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/useTheme.d.ts; ls SegmentedRadioGroup; sed -n 1,60p SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40

grep -n -B2 -A22 'ControlGroupProps\|ControlGroupOption' types.d.ts | head -70; grep -n 'Sun\|Moon' -r /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json 2>&1 | head -2; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui
